entries.title: Job 8:1
segments: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 8:2
segments: How long will you say these things, and how long will the words of your mouth be like a strong wind?

entries.title: Job 8:3
segments: Does God give wrong decisions? or is the Ruler of all not upright in his judging?

entries.title: Job 8:4
segments: If your children have done evil against him, then their punishment is from his hand.

entries.title: Job 8:5
segments: If you will make search for God with care, and put your request before the Ruler of all;

entries.title: Job 8:6
segments: If you are clean and upright; then he will certainly be moved to take up your cause, and will make clear your righteousness by building up your house again.

entries.title: Job 8:7
segments: And though your start was small, your end will be very great.

entries.title: Job 8:8
segments: ¶Put the question now to the past generations, and give attention to what has been searched out by their fathers:

entries.title: Job 8:9
segments: (For we are but of yesterday, and have no knowledge, because our days on earth are gone like a shade:)

entries.title: Job 8:10
segments: Will they not give you teaching, and say words of wisdom to you?

entries.title: Job 8:11
segments: Will the river-plant come up in its pride without wet earth? will the grass get tall without water?

entries.title: Job 8:12
segments: When it is still green, without being cut down, it becomes dry and dead before any other plant.

entries.title: Job 8:13
segments: So is the end of all who do not keep God in mind; and the hope of the evil-doer comes to nothing:

entries.title: Job 8:14
segments: Whose support is cut off, and whose hope is no stronger than a spider's thread.

entries.title: Job 8:15
segments: He is looking to his family for support, but it is not there; he puts his hope in it, but it comes to nothing.

entries.title: Job 8:16
segments: He is full of strength before the sun, and his branches go out over his garden.

entries.title: Job 8:17
segments: His roots are twisted round the stones, forcing their way in between them.

entries.title: Job 8:18
segments: If he is taken away from his place, then it will say, I have not seen you.

entries.title: Job 8:19
segments: Such is the joy of his way, and out of the dust another comes up to take his place.

entries.title: Job 8:20
segments: ¶Truly, God will not give up him who is without sin, and will not take evil-doers by the hand.

entries.title: Job 8:21
segments: The time will come when your mouth will be full of laughing, and cries of joy will come from your lips.

entries.title: Job 8:22
segments: Your haters will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the sinner will not be seen again.
